name: use-local-storage
title: useLocalStorage
description: A JSON value kept in localStorage, shaped like useState, that stays in sync across tabs.
a11y: No DOM output. Storage failures (blocked, full) fall back to memory and do not throw.
Other tabs receive changes through the storage event.
